provider_info.description: Fly.io Machines API scoped to artem-909.

connections.usage_snippet:
# Responses stream unchanged, including compressed content. Use --compressed
# to let curl negotiate and decode compression. The gateway still filters
# credentials, cookies, gateway identity and hop-by-hop headers, and manages
# HTTP framing. Requests are limited to 8 MB; redirects are not followed by
# the gateway. Custom API responses are not inspected for inference usage.
# Query-parameter auth protects echoed keys instead of passing bytes through:
# only identity/gzip responses are supported, and HTTP 206 is rejected.

# Make a GET request through the gateway
curl "https://api.sprites.dev/v1/gateway/custom_api/FGKE6qpYITmb8rKxbqQyaw/your/endpoint"

# POST with JSON body
curl -X POST "https://api.sprites.dev/v1/gateway/custom_api/FGKE6qpYITmb8rKxbqQyaw/your/endpoint" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"key": "value"}'
